fifa-professional-2023.title: FIFA Professional Football Report 2023
fifa-professional-2023.scope: 2023 men’s professional football; national association coverage and definitions.
fifa-professional-2023.limitations: 211 national pages extracted in observations/fifa_professional_2023.json. Page 38 has conflicting country identity; national sums disagree with the global headline. Unreconciled, not usable as automatic rating anchors. Employment counts are not total participation or direct measurements of the six country attributes.

fifa-big-count-2006.title: FIFA Big Count 2006 — All Players (archived original table)
fifa-big-count-2006.scope: 208 original table rows, association totals, registered/unregistered players, clubs and officials; raw facts in observations/fifa_big_count_2006.csv.
fifa-big-count-2006.limitations: This All Players table is not men-only. Association identities do not equal the Earth ISO country catalogue. Missing data must not be read as zero. Single survey year cannot substantiate an annual 1955–2026 history.
